scope: Phase 17 source ownership, preservation, dependency metadata and recorded host drift only; this report does not certify execution gates, deployment, or whole-phase completion.

observedStart.note: Observation after parallel task dispatch and before root edits; Phase16 frozen manifest remains the immutable previous-phase reference.

provenanceSelection.limitations: Each side uses its own recorded selector. Deltas cover the union of selected paths only; absence from a manifest may reflect selection changes. Unselected external work is not exhaustively audited or certified.

sharedRegistrationMeaning: Shared CI and backend main fingerprints are recorded separately. A current shared-file change is not certified by a successful run against the frozen candidate; only the Phase 17 cfg(test) module registration is checked here.

retiredReference.meaning: Only the leading deprecation comment may change. Equal remaining bytes preserve historical helper behavior; this is not Rust authorization execution evidence.

dependencies.reason: reqwest supplies the existing mandated HTTPS client; chrono validates RFC3339 context expiry; serde_json is promoted from dev to production. Existing locked packages are retained, no platform implementation dependency or new workspace.
dependencies.limitation: Package identity preservation and license declarations only; not a full vulnerability, security, license compatibility or legal compliance audit.
